maker: Han's Robot (Guangdong Huayan Robotics Co., Ltd.)
name: Han's Robot STAR Mobile Manipulator
summary: A series of mobile manipulators that put a Han's Elfin cobot (E03 to E15) on a laser-SLAM AMR (HR150 to HR1200) with vision, gripper and automatic charging, for handling, CNC loading and assembly; running time with load from more than 6 h to more than 12 h depending on size.

germany.statusNote: Han's Robot (Shenzhen) takes purchase enquiries by web form and marketing.oversea@huayan-robotics.com; its contact and distributor pages list only Chinese offices and no EU distributor.

notes: The maker describes the system as arm, mobile robot, vision system and gripper combined; arm payload depends on the Elfin model (E03 to E15) and is not stated on this page.
Platform payload not stated; tray lifting unit customisable.
Runtime is the smallest model's figure; larger models run more than 10 to 12 h.
